article.title: Application of other provisions of Act.
article.content: Save as otherwise provided in this part, all other provisions of this Act shall apply to assessment made under this part.
article.html:
300Application of other provisions of Act.

Section 300 · Chapter XVI · B.—Special procedure for assessment of search cases · page 364 of the Act

Save as otherwise provided in this part, all other provisions of this Act shall apply to assessment made under this part.
